description: Add a video transition (by match name, from list_available_effects) at the start, end or both ends of video clips, with a duration and optionally single-sided, or replace the transition already there. One undo step

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

replace.description: Remove the transition already at that end first (Replace transition); there must be one. Default false

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

singleSided.description: Keep the transition on this clip only. Default false

name: add_transition
title: Add Transition
